name: video-studio
description: Provider-neutral knowledge-to-video compiler: turns text, URLs, documents and repos into reproducible videos with captions, thumbnails and provenance.

elevenlabs_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
elevenlabs_key.description: Optional. ElevenLabs key for voiceover and word timings (ELEVENLABS_API_KEY).

runway_key.title: Runway API key
runway_key.description: Not used yet (Phase 7, providers): Runway Gen-4 / Gen-4.5 generative video. Safe to set now; it has no effect until that integration ships (RUNWAYML_API_SECRET).

heygen_key.title: HeyGen API key
heygen_key.description: Not used yet (Phase 7, providers): HeyGen v3 presenter videos. Safe to set now; it has no effect until that integration ships (HEYGEN_API_KEY).

fal_key.title: fal.ai API key
fal_key.description: Not used yet (Phase 7, providers): Kling, Veo, Hailuo, Seedance and Wan through fal.ai. Safe to set now; it has no effect until that integration ships (FAL_KEY).

kling_key.title: Kling API key
kling_key.description: Not used yet (Phase 7, providers): direct Kling API. Safe to set now; it has no effect until that integration ships (KLINGAI_API_KEY).
